plain.li: [ransom,warm] Thank you for writing, {WRITER}. We want our own home, and we will send someone to your gate.
[ransom,cordial] Your letter about the captives reached us. Someone of ours will come to your gate about it.
[ransom,cordial,theirLowtech] The elders have heard your words about the one you hold. Our answer will come to your gate on foot.
[ransom,cool] We have your letter. Someone will come to your gate about it, and that is all we will say here.
[ransom,cool,war] You hold one of ours and write to us about it. Very well, our answer will come to your gate.
[ransom,cool,war,theirHightech] Your proposal regarding the prisoners has been reviewed. Expect contact at your gate.
[ransom,cool,call] Understood, {WRITER}. We'll be at your gate about it.
[ransom,refusal] We will not bargain over that, {WRITER}.
[ransom,refusal,war] We do not pay our enemies, and we do not trade with them either.
[ransom,refusal,theirLowtech] The elders talked late about your words, and the answer is no.
[ransom,refusal,theirHightech] Your proposal was discussed and declined.
[ransom,refusal,call] No deal, {WRITER}. Don't call about it again.
[envoy,warm] We would be honored, {WRITER}. Our envoy will come and live among you for the season.
[envoy,warm,theirLowtech] The elders are glad. Our guest-friend will come and sit by your fire.
[envoy,cordial] Gladly, {WRITER}. Our envoy will come to you as soon as the road allows.
[envoy,cordial,theirHightech] Request approved. Our envoy will travel to you with credentials in hand.
[envoy,cool] Very well. Our envoy will come for the season.
[envoy,refusal] We can't spare our envoy this season, {WRITER}.
[envoy,refusal,theirLowtech] Our guest-friend is needed by our own fire this season.
[greetings,cordial,envoy:here] Thank you for writing, {WRITER}. We hear our envoy has settled in at your colony.
[greetings,warm,envoy:ours] Your envoy is welcome among us, {WRITER}, and so is your letter.
[news,cordial,envoy:ours] Your envoy will have told you most of this, but here is our news all the same.
[greetings,cool,ransom:held] We have your letter. We have not forgotten the one of yours we hold, and neither have you.
[greetings,cool,ransom:theirs] We have your letter, and we have not forgotten that you hold one of ours.
[ransompay,us] Here is the silver your people asked for.
[ransompay,us] It's all there, so count it if you like.
[ransompay,us,theirLowtech] Here is the silver, so carry it to your elders.
[ransomthanks,them] Then it's done, and yours will be home soon.
[ransomthanks,them] I'll carry it home tonight, and they'll keep their side.
[ransomset,them] Here is the price we agreed.
[ransomset,them,theirLowtech] These goods are the price the elders agreed.
[ransomset,them] Count it, then send our people out.
[exchangegate,them] Here is yours, as we agreed, so send ours out.
[exchangegate,them,theirLowtech] One for one, as the elders said.
[exchangeask,us] We hold one of yours, and you hold one of ours.
[exchangeask,us] I'd like to talk about a trade of captives.
[exchangeask,us,theirLowtech] Would your elders trade a captive for a captive?
[exchangetalk,them] That isn't mine alone to decide.
[exchangetalk,us] One for one, walked out at the gate at the same moment.
[exchangetalk,them] And who goes first?
[exchangeyes,them] Then it's agreed, and I'll send word home today.
[exchangeyes,them,theirLowtech] It is agreed, one for one, by the old way.
[exchangeno,them] My people won't trade that one, not for that.
[exchangeno,them] No, I can't agree to it.
[envoyletter,them] Take this home to the council, and keep it dry.
[envoyletter,them,theirLowtech] Carry these words to the elders by the fire.
[envoyletter,them] Here is my letter, and tell them I'm well.
